data.name: Ruins of The Titan
data.detailed_description:
The story unfolds on a shattered continent, plunged into chaos after the fall of the Creator God. The absence of the divine has caused turmoil and unrest, leaving the world in endless darkness and confusion. You, summoned by mysterious forces, are tasked with vanquishing the factions and restoring the lost light.

 

… or is it really that simple? 

 

“That Time I Got Summoned to a New World as a Hero or Becoming a God” 

 

Unleash Stylish Combos in a Scroll-Style Action World

Slash, sweep, pierce, then spin through your enemies!

In this exciting and flashy battle journey, traverse perilous ruins, wield your weapon with smooth actions and sharp judgment, showcase your combo skills as you cut down hordes of enemies, challenge bosses, and and finish them off with a cinematic execution move!

 

Challenging foes + impactful combat (with everyone's favorite invincible dodge) = a satisfying gaming experience

Enchant your moves and Build Your Own Combat in a world of swords and magic

Combine launchers, slams, aerial attacks, blocks, dodges, basic attacks, and charged attacks to unleash relentless combos and never give your enemies a chance to breathe!

 

Vortex, Magic Sword, Sword Summoning, Dash, Clone, Magic Circle, Fire, Ice, Lightning — 9 different skill types are yours to mix and match! With hundreds of possible skill and move combinations, create your own unique combat style.

 

Skills can also be combined with Blessings, Inscriptions, and resource systems to create all kinds of hybrid builds.

 

Transform into one of the Bosses with a powerful special skill, build a devastating aerial combo around air skills, or trigger stylish “Bullet Time” effects with dodge skills…

 

With endless possibilities, find the combination that feels best to you and define your own way to fight.

 

Combine your sword attacks with Fire, Ice, and Lightning magic. Each element comes with its own unique effects, adding even more variety to combat.

 

Weave them into your combos and create devastating skill combinations. In the heat of battle, you’ll need to think fast, find the right combinations, overcome danger, and turn the tide of battle if you want to make it to the end of your journey.

 

Stylish and varied moves deliver smooth, satisfying, and impactful combat, while fast-paced exploration and battles keep the adventure moving. Every choice can change the course of your run.

 

A rich variety of enemies ensures your adventure never gets boring

Fight a wide variety of regular enemies, elite enemies, and flying units, each bringing a different challenge to the battlefield.

 

From towering giants to monstrous lords, face 20+ unique Bosses. Every enemy has its own attack patterns and behaviors, making each battle a fresh challenge that is difficult, but fair.

 

4 Difficulty Modes for All Types of Players

Choose from four difficulty levels—from casual hack-and-slash to hardcore Souls-like battles.

 

Key Features

  • 5 chapters with diverse environments and maps

  •  9 skill archetypes and 346+ skills

  •  112+ enemy types

  •  20+ Bosses

  •  80+ in-run Blessings

  •  70+ out-of-run Inscriptions

  •  20+ in-run Curses

  •  20+ anomaly event options

  •  20+ shop items

  •  12 types of basic items

  •  41 loot rule sets

  •  15+ types of combat pressure / challenge rules

We are a team of freshly graduated university students, and through our passion and research for gaming, we present this game, hoping to create a thrilling action game with excellent hit feedback for all players!

data.short_description: A 2D Rougelike action game with pixel art style. You are a summoned "hero", in exhilarating combat, smooth action and dazzling combo, defeat and execute enemies. Build from 100+ skills! Blending adventure, action, and strategic builds, the journey offers endless possibilities in every fight.
